name: Excel import source explorer and review queue
description: Verify workbook history, sheet classification, source cells, previews, reviews, and safe import actions.

planSteps.description: The import page shows upload control and workbook history
Open the most recent successfully imported workbook
Workbook detail shows metadata, classified sheet list, review access, and available module import actions
Open one sheet and inspect raw data plus extraction preview
Raw cell values, formulas when present, pagination, source coordinates, and preview content render without error
Open the workbook review queue and use filters; open one review without changing its status
Review reason, status, source row, audit information, and accept/resolve/reject controls are visible
Return to workbook detail and click each safe idempotent module import action that is available
Repeated import actions complete without duplicate records or server errors and show a clear result
